newsitem.title: USA: Nissan recalling 84,000 vehicles in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Nissan recalling 84,000 vehicles in U.S.

text.p: Nissan Motor Corp U.S.A., a unit of Nissan Motor Co Ltd, said Tuesday it issued a voluntary recall of about 84,000 vehicles to inspect and possibly replace front seat belt buckles.
Recalled are 60,000 of its 1994 model year trucks, built from November 1993 through April 1994, and 24,000 of its 1994 model year sport utility Pathfinders built from November 1993 and March 1994.
Nissan said that due to manufacturing tolerance error, the seat belt tongue may not fully engage if it is not firmly inserted into the buckle.
This may result in the seat belt becoming unfastened in the event of a collision or hard braking of the vehicle.
To date, the company said no injuries have been reported as a result of this situation. Nissan will inspect the seat belt buckles and replace them, if necessary, without charge to the customer.
